_llm_instructions: Populate the fields of 'RESOURCE BREAKDOWN STRUCTURE' and write the value of each field under 'Generated Value', based on the project context. Context: the project carrying reference PMO-04.06.03.

f01_RBS_Code.label: RBS Code
f01_RBS_Code.guidance: The position of the node in the hierarchy, written as 1, 1.1, 1.1.1 so a reader can reconstruct the tree from the text alone. A node numbered 1.2.1 with no 1.2 above it means a level was skipped.

f02_Resource_Node.label: Resource Node
f02_Resource_Node.guidance: What the node names. A first-level node is the project, a second-level node is a resource category such as people or equipment, and a third-level node is an individual resource carrying its quantity. A category node with nothing beneath it leaves the branch empty.

f03_Chart_Form.label: Chart Form
f03_Chart_Form.guidance: Which view the chart takes: a mindmap for a single hierarchy, or a flowchart where the nodes carry relationships rather than only parentage. Stated so a reader knows what the diagram is meant to show.

f04_Node_Labels.label: Node Labels
f04_Node_Labels.guidance: The node labels, one per line, in the same order as the outline. The chart and the outline must agree: a branch present in one and absent from the other is the defect this section exists to prevent.
